name: Send AI-written follow-ups to sales leads who have not replied
description: Every weekday morning, finds the leads in a Google Sheet that are due for a follow-up and lets an AI agent write the next touch: a new angle, a case study, a useful link or a check-in. The email goes out by Gmail and the next follow-up date is written back to the sheet. After five touches the agent stops and the lead is marked cold.
shortDescription: Send AI-written follow-up emails to leads who have not replied, on a schedule kept in a Google Sheet.
keyFeatures: Picks only leads whose status is contacted or nurturing and whose nextTouch date has arrived
A follow-up ladder by touch count: new angle, case study, useful article, personal check-in, then stop
Links only from an editable CONTENT LIBRARY block, so the agent never invents a URL
The agent returns send or stop as JSON, and a condition either emails and reschedules or marks the lead cold
Dates stored as yyyyMMdd numbers so the sheet's locale formatting cannot break the comparison
Part of a set of five sales templates that share one Google Sheet: prospecting, nurture, negotiation, booking and proposal.
prerequisites: A Google Sheet with a Leads tab whose header row is: name, email, company, domain, linkedinUrl, phone, status, channel, offer, touchCount, nextTouch, lastMessage, notes; replace REPLACE_WITH_SPREADSHEET_ID with its ID. The prospecting template fills status, touchCount and nextTouch, or you can fill them yourself
Edit the OFFER and CONTENT LIBRARY blocks in the AI agent's system prompt, and change the schedule's timezone from UTC to yours
idealFor: Freelancers and small sales teams that lose deals to silence and want polite, varied follow-ups sent without a drip-campaign tool.
steps: Read the Leads tab and loop over the rows.
Keep only leads that are contacted or nurturing, have an email and are due today or earlier.
The AI agent writes the next touch for the lead's touch count, or returns stop after five touches.
Send: email the follow-up with Gmail and write status nurturing, the new touchCount, the next date and the message to the row.
Stop: mark the lead cold and clear nextTouch.
